lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 6 distinct high-contrast white vertical lines are visible; spacing is relatively uniform through the mid-section with a slight increase in inter-line distance toward the posterior flank.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The posterior-most vertical line (6th from anterior) is abbreviated, terminating mid-torso without reaching the ventral fringe.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Low-density grouping of 3 distinct high-contrast white spots located on the upper haunch area near the base of the white caudal fringe.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Spiral lyrate curvature; horns initiate vertically from the skull base, arc laterally, and curve inward toward the terminal points.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: Estimated 1.5:1 ratio between the distance between terminal tips and the horizontal width of the horn bases.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.12 (12%) of the distal horn structure exhibits high-contrast ivory-toned tipping relative to the total vertical length.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of three avian organisms (Oxpeckers) on the dorsal neck and upper shoulder acting as temporal markers; no permanent cutaneous scars or anomalies visible.
other_distinctive_markers: Two distinct white spots on the lateral cheek region below the eye; prominent white dorsal mane extending along the spinal ridge.
